stem: A worker finds USDA hemp guidance while researching authorization for a non-hemp cannabis activity. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: The hemp source may illustrate a verification method, but it does not establish authorization for the non-hemp activity; the correct controlling authority must still be identified
USDA hemp guidance automatically authorizes all cannabis cultivation
Any federal agricultural source overrides state and local requirements
The activity is authorized if the worker completed an Academy course
rationale: Hemp and non-hemp cannabis must not be conflated; the activity and jurisdiction determine the controlling authority.
